attributes.board_name: Massachusetts Board of Registration for Speech-Language Pathology and Audiology

rules.accepted_credit_types: Continuing Education Programs, Publications (sole author up to 20 h, co-authors 10 h each per publication), Instruction (1 h per hour taught, initial offering only, max 10 h) and Academic Courses (max 10 h). Only non-duplicative activities completed in the 2 years before the renewal date count.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Initial license 6–12 months before the end of the renewal period: 10 hours (at least 4 in the area of licensure). Initial license 6 months or less before the end of the period: no CE for that renewal.
rules.audit_note: Licensees attest on the Board's renewal form; the Board may randomly audit and request proof (title, hours, sponsor/approver, completion date) for the two most recent renewal periods.
rules.notes: Biennial renewal. At least 10 of the 20 hours must be in the licensee's area of licensure. Holders of both SLP and audiology licenses: 30 hours per period, at least 10 in the major and at least 5 in the minor area of clinical service. 260 CMR 7.00 names only SLPs and audiologists; it sets no CE hours for the licensed SLP assistants and audiology assistants (who also renew every 2 years). Expiration date basis is not stated on the Board's pages.
rules.rule_quote: 1. Licensees holding a license as either a Speech-language Pathologist or Audiologist are required, as a condition of license renewal, to complete a minimum of the equivalent of 20 Continuing Education Hours per licensure renewal period (every two years).
